procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1870 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/washington/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (11/11; the X-celled rows' blanks are proven 0 by their own printed TOTALs).
structure_note: Five-page shape ('WASHINGTON COUNTY MS 11/03/2026 GENERAL ELECTION' banner): p1 the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A over the county's 19 precincts (11 columns, then Metcalfe Municipal Building/.../Washington County Multiplex Building + TOTAL) carrying Senate, House D2, Court of Appeals 2 Position 1, Chancery 9-1, and Circuit 4's Places 2-3 sections; p4+p5 = table B over the same 8+TOTAL column split carrying Circuit 4 Place 4 and the local sections (Circuit 4-4's section RE-OPENS on p5 across the Metcalfe column group -- the same rows' tails; the sheet's own place prints sit on both pages). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District (Ron Eller, Bennie G. Thompson, Bennie Foster -- the House 2 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald -- the CoA 2 roster, name identical); Chancery Court 9-1-Chancery District 9-1 (Bennie L. Richard -- the same candidate Humphreys prints; the accepted place-spread divergence covers this family); Circuit Court 4-2-Circuit District 4-2 (Margaret Carey-McCray), 4-3 (Carol White Richard), 4-4 (Ashley Hines, p4+p5 cells) -- Circuit 4's Places 2/3/4 (no Place 1 section; Carey-McCray is the same candidate Sunflower prints as 'Carey-McCrady', spelled '-McCray' on this sheet). Printed totals: Colom 9073, Hyde-Smith 2425, Pinkins 171, Eller 2425, G. Thompson 8962, Foster 276, McDonald 9221, Bennie L. Richard 9781, Carey-McCray 3497, Carol White Richard 681, Ashley Hines 5590.
operator_rows_note: All 11 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3 cells + the p3 printed TOTAL; Hines' p4 circuit row carries p4+p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. The X-celled rows supply only the numeric cells plus the printed TOTAL (Carey-McCray: p2's Darlove 0 + Elks 859 + Extension 274 + Lake Vista 613 + Leland Health 842 + Leland Rotary 621 = 3209 + p3 Metcalfe 288 = 3497; Carol White Richard: 7+38+636 = 681; Ashley Hines: p4 2150 + p5 3440 = 5590) -- the X-marked blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL, the established X-cell rule.
truncation_note: No truncations; the nineteen precinct headers print complete (Arcola Technology Center, Buster Brown Community Center, Covenant Presbyterian Church, Darlove, Elks Lodge, Extension Building, Glen Allan Library, Jake's Chapel MB Church, Lake Vista Masonic Lodge, Leland Health Department, Leland Rotary Club, Metcalfe Municipal Building, Mount Bethel Baptist Church, Restoration Church, Riverside Fire Department, Tampa Drive, Ward's Recreation Center, Washington County Convention Center, Washington County Multiplex Building -- the sheet's own forms kept verbatim).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 4 Place 4: 'School District H-5-Hollandale School Board Trustee H-5' (Dorothy Smith Jernigan, Cecelia Moton), 'School District L-4-Leland School Board Trustee L-4' (Patricia Burton Barber, Nashobeya Wright), 'Washington-County Court Judge' (Tonya Franklin, Debra Michelle Giles) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages.

accepted_roster_divergences.note: Place spread plus a one-letter name-spelling variance across the district's counties: this county's recap prints Place 2 (Margaret Carey-McCray -- Sunflower's certified recap spells the same candidate 'Margaret Carey-McCrady'), Place 3 (Carol White Richard, identical to Sunflower's/Leflore's), and Place 4 (Ashley Hines, printed here alone); Sunflower additionally prints Place 1 (Richard A. Smith). Each county keeps its own printed spellings and sections; the seat-blind family gate's incomparable-roster record is accepted as printed-ballot place/name structure with every row's TOTAL arithmetic verified against this sheet.
